name: Trebuchet
lore: A siege mortar on treads, built to level a position before the assault. It stakes itself to the ground before it fires.

weapons.name: Arc Howitzer
weapons.lore: The Paladin's gun made a siege piece: a long charge, then one great round of plasma lobbed high that bursts in lightning where it lands. Outranges every other mobile gun in the Reach inventory.
